runtime_inputs.method: Matched the 7,858 paths against the candidate Git tree, including all ten baseline/candidate shader SHA-256 values and all six adapted capture harnesses. Hashed 6,522 hydrated candidate files directly. For the other 1,336 paths, enumerated locally available Git objects, then streamed only committed IDs with lazy fetching disabled. For 31 paths whose committed bytes use LF but whose .gitattributes prescribe CRLF, hashed the checkout bytes produced by git cat-file --filters. All 7,858 identities match the hosted 9d manifest. Complete manifest bytes are compared on every shard.

hardware_qualification.observed_local_environment: No /dev/dri or /dev/nvidia0; no pool profile at /tmp/OpenRC/testpool/config.json. OPENRC_TESTPOOL_CONFIG, OPENRC_TESTQUEUE and SSH_AUTH_SOCK absent. No Tailscale executable or sim_fleet/testqueue connector advertised in this session.
hardware_qualification.measurement_scope: The hosted jobs identify llvmpipe or lavapipe. Their CPU/RSS and render-loop timings characterize software rendering on the hosted machine. The target physical GPU has no comparable receipt here.

timing_interpretation.field_wall: Measured post-draw loop intervals. One bootstrap interval is removed from 31 samples in each field invocation.
timing_interpretation.viewport_cpu: Elapsed CPU-side time between viewport begin/end markers. In GLES this uses OS::get_ticks_usec and can include waiting. This is not consumed process CPU.
timing_interpretation.viewport_gpu: The getters return cached marker differences. GLES records GL_TIMESTAMP with three query slots; the render server dispatches post-draw before processing available captured timestamps. Unique positive numbers can still refer to earlier frames. The fixture provides no query/source-frame ID for a poll.
timing_interpretation.process_cpu_and_memory: Direct Godot process user+system CPU seconds and sampled peak resident memory include startup. Engine-reported video memory is retained separately.
timing_interpretation.host_scope: Each workload records its VM name, OS/kernel, machine architecture and configured Mesa threading. The artifacts do not identify the CPU SKU or host core count. LP_NUM_THREADS=2 limits software-rasterizer threads. Cross-host speed differences cannot be assigned to the shader from these records.

headland_followup.status: First-candidate field-entry rejected for regional visual acceptance. Corrected source admitted for hosted A/B qualification.
headland_followup.source_scope: The new implementation treats the fixed 0.35/0.40/0.23 headland pigment as a chosen display-authored swatch before the existing 0.28 mix. The helper is identity on Compatibility and decodes the constant to 0.10048151/0.13286832/0.04323364 on the rendering-device route. The mesh palette is already decoded; stubble, lane paint, photos and multipliers are outside this one-swatch change.
spatial_controls: Repeat original matched field-entry camera and evaluate the fixed interior/headland patches around (1800,512)/(1800,584). The 9d Forward+ green gap was 70 display values.
Check the whole parcel and the native crop for a remaining bright wedge or a newly dark one. Preserve the interior palette and road-track response.
Compatibility local headland appearance should remain identical. Verify lane/median and road controls using the same highway camera.
headland_followup.qualification: Regional colour acceptance is an editorial assessment. It does not establish the historical authoring space of other literals.

original_field_aggregate_review.method: Recomputed each launch and both 60-interval pools per case from raw frame and viewport arrays. Verified throughput, instantaneous-FPS median, frame p50, nearest-rank p95, count and median of positive CPU/GPU polls; independently recovered maximum sampled RSS, summed CPU deltas and adjacent AB/BA percent changes. No fourth pilot_north baseline was available for this aggregate on Forward+.

initial_campaign_outcome.partial_workload: Forward+ field:pilot_north. Its first pair and candidate repeat are valid, its fourth baseline was canceled before producing an image or field report.
